| Concept | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [Risk watch](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Answers "has any department risk crossed its escalation trigger this month?". Reads the early indicators against the six-row risk register: finds the monitorable value per risk, reads it from its source with a date, compares it with the trigger, classifies each risk as triggered, on watch, clear or unreadable (no source), and drafts the risk reading for the OD lead. It never scores risks. Use when the monthly risk review is due, before a COP round, after a blocked rollout or a Cyber Security finding, or when someone asks whether a risk needs escalation. Not for the monthly improvement decision (dept-retro) or for judging one use case or project risk (deploy-project-order). |
